title: From selfie to shelf: how AI skin analysis is changing beauty retail
summary: AI skin analysis is moving beyond the digital consultation. For beauty retailers, the technology is becoming a product discovery tool, connecting individual skin needs with ingredients and products across e-commerce and physical stores

extraction.key_fact: 인공지능 피부 분석 기술이 단순 상담을 넘어 이커머스와 오프라인 매장에서 개인 맞춤형 제품을 발굴하는 도구로 진화하고 있다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: For beauty retailers, the technology is becoming a product discovery tool, connecting individual skin needs with ingredients and products across e-commerce and physical stores
